summary: Completed testing for Sponsors CRUD and Roster Coaches features. All features working correctly: 1) Homepage has 'Friends & Sponsors' tab, 2) Team pages have 'Sponsors' tab, 3) Sponsors CRUD fully functional (create/read/update/delete), 4) Admin users see '+ Add Sponsor' button with full form, 5) Team roster shows players in grid layout. Coaches section logic is correct but team has no assigned coaches to display.
critical_code_review_comments: SponsorsDisplay.js lines 16-22: isAdmin check correctly validates admin/league_admin/coach roles
SponsorsDisplay.js lines 26-42: loadSponsors correctly uses teamId for /api/teams/{teamId}/sponsors OR /api/sponsors for league level
SponsorsDisplay.js lines 50-68: handleSave correctly POSTs new sponsor or PUTs update with scope and teamId
HomePage.js lines 308-316: sponsors tab correctly renders with '🤝 Friends & Sponsors' text
TeamDetailPage.js lines 116-117: sponsors tab included in tabs array for team pages
TeamRosterTab.js lines 85-95: fetchCoaches correctly calls /api/teams/{team_id}/coaches endpoint
TeamRosterTab.js lines 463-491: Coaches section renders with data-testid='coaches-section' when coaches array has items
server.py lines 1082-1156: Sponsors CRUD endpoints all working - GET/POST /api/sponsors, PUT/DELETE /api/sponsors/{id}, GET /api/teams/{team_id}/sponsors
seed_data_creation: Test sponsors created and cleaned up during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sponsors CRUD fully verified. Homepage has 'Friends & Sponsors' tab showing league sponsors. Team pages have 'Sponsors' tab showing team-specific sponsors. Admin/coach users can add/edit/delete sponsors. Roster page shows coaches section ONLY when /api/teams/{team_id}/coaches returns coaches - Eagles team has no coaches assigned so section doesn't appear. Players display in grid layout (11 players for Eagles).
